title: My ex gave me and my best friend the same Christmas gift

voice.name: Kitty
voice.direction: sultry, smirking, brisk TikTok storytelling pace

hooks.text: My ex-best friend showed up to Friendsgiving uninvited.
My ex gave me and my best friend the same gift.
One leather jacket ended a friendship. Two ended a man.

beats.text: My ex-best friend showed up to *Friendsgiving* uninvited.
beats.visual: Door swings open on a cozy dinner table; Mia in the doorway holding a pie. Text hook: SHE SHOWED UP.

beats.text: Mia. The one who hooked up with my *ex*.
beats.visual: Tiff at the table, fork frozen; Jake's photo flickers behind Mia.

beats.text: Everyone went quiet. Even the *turkey* looked away.
beats.visual: Wide: friends around the table, all eyes on Tiff.

beats.text: She said: I'm not here to apologize. I'm here about the *jacket*.
beats.visual: Mia close-up, serious; sets the pie down.

beats.text: The leather one Jake gave me for *Christmas*.
beats.visual: Insert: Tiff's black leather jacket with a gift tag.

beats.text: She pulled out the *exact same* jacket.
beats.visual: Mia unzips her bag: an identical leather jacket.

beats.text: Same size. Same gift note. Same *Christmas*.
beats.visual: Two gift notes side by side: identical handwriting, 'for my favorite girl'.

beats.text: He bought *one present* and gave it to us both.
beats.visual: Tiff and Mia face to face, jackets in hand.

beats.text: We *stared* at each other for a full minute.
beats.visual: Slow creep on the two of them; a clock ticks.

beats.text: So we listed both jackets on *pileGo* that night.
beats.visual: Tiff's room at night: both snap their jackets, listings go out to app tiles.

beats.text: Mine sold for two hundred dollars. Hers was a *knockoff*.
beats.visual: Two sale cards: Tiff's 'SOLD $200', Mia's flagged 'NOT AUTHENTIC'.

beats.text: Funny. Now she's finally mad at the right *person*.
beats.visual: Mia glaring at her phone with Jake's name on it; Tiff sips cocoa.
